verdict.rationale: The core Semgrep engine is hosted on a public GitHub repo (semgrep-gh-1/2/3), showing source code is publicly readable, but no evidence pack item states an explicit open-source license (e.g., LGPL) or points to a LICENSE file. Community evidence also notes that a commercial component, Semgrep Supply Chain, is explicitly 'not open source' (semgrep-comm-12), meaning the broader product is not uniformly open-licensed. missing for 10: explicit license text/citation, confirmation covering all product components, independent verification of license terms.
